source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Research Questions and Hypotheses' under topic 7.1 (PDF 94, printed 90).

blocks.text: Research questions batate hain ke kis cheez ki study ho rahi hai. Hypothesis research question se banta hai. Sawal data jama karne ki rehnumai karte hain, aur hypotheses un sawalon ke mumkin jawab dete hain. Wazeh sawal se wazeh hypothesis banta hai; dono aapas mein qareebi tor par jure hain. Achhi research achhe sawalon se shuru hoti hai. Hypotheses analysis ko focused rakhte hain aur study ko sahi simt (direction) dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Is research sawal ko test ke qabil hypothesis banayein: 'Kya zyada sone wale talaba zyada score karte hain?'
blocks.explanation: Maslan: 'Raat ko kam az kam aath ghante sone wale talaba ka average score kam sone walon se zyada hai.' Is mein qabil-e-paimaish variables (neend ke ghante, average score) aur mutawaqqa farq shamil hai.
